HEADING: Webhooks
INTRO_TEXT: FastComments supports webhooks for Comments. All payloads are signed with an HMAC signature. Every webhook below is delivered independently, so you can send the same event to several endpoints or scope endpoints to specific domains.
DOCUMENTATION_LINK_TEXT: For documentation and the request structure, see here.
NOSCRIPT_MESSAGE: JavaScript is required for this UI to function properly.
RECENT_FAILURES_MESSAGE: ❗ You have recent webhook failures. Try checking the logs.
WEBHOOK_STATUS_FAILING_NO_SUCCESS: ⚠️ Failing since [date]. No successful deliveries yet.
WEBHOOK_AUTO_DISABLED_EXPLANATION: Automatically disabled on [date] after about a week of failed deliveries. Queued events are kept and will be delivered once you fix the endpoint and re-enable it.
WEBHOOK_MANUALLY_DISABLED_EXPLANATION: Disabled on [date]. Queued events are kept and will be delivered once it is re-enabled.
WEBHOOK_DISABLE_CONFIRM: Disable this webhook? Events will be kept, but not delivered until it is re-enabled.
WEBHOOK_DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this webhook? Its queued events will be discarded.
ERROR_GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ERROR_DUPLICATE: A webhook with this URL, event and domain already exists.
ERROR_URL_INVALID: The URL must be an absolute http:// or https:// URL.
ERROR_DOMAIN_INVALID: Select All Domains or one of your configured domains.
API_SOURCE_NOTE: This webhook was created through the API, for example by Zapier. You can edit or delete it here, but the subscriber will not be told about your changes.
FIELD_URL_HELP: The endpoint that receives the signed payload. The HMAC signature is sent in the X-FastComments-Signature header.
FIELD_DOMAIN_HELP: Only comments on this domain are sent. All Domains receives comments from every domain, including alongside domain-specific webhooks.
FIELD_METHOD_HELP: Create and update deliveries with PUT are idempotent. Some receivers drop the body of DELETE requests, so POST is the safest choice.
